no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not taken to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected and there were no controversial issues that would benefit from discussion by an advisory committee.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the INMAZEB (REGN-EB3) BLA. The Multidiscipline Review states the application was not taken to an advisory committee because it did not raise unexpected safety or efficacy issues and had no controversial issues warranting AC discussion; the regulatory-history section adds that it was not presented at the Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee given its Breakthrough Therapy designation and a non-controversial benefit-risk assessment. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
